Class UciEngineAI

java.lang.Object
com.lacavedeharol.chess.computer.uci.UciEngineAI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChessAI
public final class UciEngineAI extends Object implements ChessAI
A ChessAI backed by an external UCI engine. Builds a FEN from the game state, asks the engine for a move, and applies it back. Works with any engine described by an EngineConfig (Stockfish today; Leela/Maia or others later).
